result.stdout:
OllamaCleanup inspects reclaimable Ollama model storage.

Usage: OllamaCleanup --find-old --find-orphaned --find-studio-cache --remove-old
--remove-orphaned --remove-studio-cache --days <n> --apply --yes

Options:
  --find-old Show old blobs in the report.
  --find-orphaned Show orphaned blobs in the report.
  --find-studio-cache Show standalone LM Studio cache files under .studio_links.
  --remove-old Include old blobs in the deletion set.
  --remove-orphaned Include orphaned blobs in the deletion set.
  --remove-studio-cache Include standalone LM Studio cache files in the deletion
set.
  --days <n> Age threshold in days. Default is 180.
  --apply Perform deletion. Without this flag the tool is dry-run only.
  --yes Skip the confirmation prompt.
  --help Show this help text.
